Summary.en: Validates a time range so the minimum time cannot be after the maximum time.
Summary.de: Validiert einen Zeitbereich, sodass die Mindestzeit nicht nach der Höchstzeit liegt.
Summary.it: Convalida un intervallo di orari affinché l'orario minimo non sia successivo a quello massimo.

Parameter.MaxField: CSS selector selecting the input element that takes the maximum time.
Parameter.MsgMinInvalid: The error message shown when the minimum field's value is after the one in the maximum field.
Parameter.MsgMaxInvalid: The error message shown when the maximum field's value is before the one in the minimum field.
Parameter.EqualityPermitted: Whether the same start and end time is permitted.

MaxField.default: CSS selector selecting the input element that takes the maximum time.

MsgMinInvalid.default: The error message shown when the minimum field's value is after the one in the maximum field.

MsgMaxInvalid.default: The error message shown when the maximum field's value is before the one in the minimum field.

EqualityPermitted.default: whether the same start and end time is permitted.
